title: Delicious Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear amounts and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to provide adequate iron and folate to ensure the health of both mother and baby. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports fetal development. In this article, we'll introduce three delicious and iron-rich recipes that can be prepared in under 30 minutes.

## Nutrient Analysis
Iron and folate are two crucial nutrients during pregnancy. Iron can be found in foods like red meat, chicken, fish, and leafy greens. Folate is also found in leafy greens, fruits, and whole grains. To enhance iron absorption, combine it with vitamin C, found in foods like oranges, lemons, and bell peppers.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken Bowl with Mixed Greens and Orange
* 100g grilled chicken
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed greens
* 1 orange
* 1 tablespoon olive oil
* Salt and pepper

Grill the chicken in the oven at 200°C for 20 minutes. Heat olive oil in a pan and add mixed greens. Cook for 2-3 minutes until the greens are tender. Mix cooked rice with grilled chicken, mixed greens, and orange juice.

## Recipe 2: Grilled Fish Bowl with Bok Choy and Bell Pepper
* 100g grilled fish
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup bok choy
* 1 bell pepper
* 1 tablespoon olive oil
* Salt and pepper

Grill the fish in the oven at 200°C for 15 minutes. Heat olive oil in a pan and add bok choy. Cook for 2-3 minutes until the bok choy is tender. Mix cooked rice with grilled fish, bok choy, and bell pepper.

## Recipe 3: Beef Stir-Fry Bowl with Water Spinach and Lemon
* 100g beef stir-fry
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup water spinach
* 1 lemon
* 1 tablespoon olive oil
* Salt and pepper

Stir-fry the beef in a pan with olive oil for 3-4 minutes until cooked. Add water spinach to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes until tender. Mix cooked rice with beef stir-fry, water spinach, and lemon juice.

## Food Safety Notes
During pregnancy, it's essential to avoid eating raw or undercooked foods like sushi, sashimi, and raw meat. Choose cooked foods and ensure food safety.

## Conclusion
These three recipes provide a rich source of iron and folate, supporting the health of both mother and baby during pregnancy. Remember to combine iron with vitamin C to enhance absorption. For more information on prenatal nutrition, visit our [meal planner](/planner) or [read more about pregnancy recipes](/blog/topics).

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about prenatal nutrition, consult your doctor or a registered dietitian. They can provide personalized guidance and support to ensure a healthy pregnancy.
